ios.desc:
Track your food. Transform your life.

Beyond Macros is the most advanced AI-powered nutrition tracker ever built. Designed for those who want to go deeper than just counting calories or macros, it makes food logging effortless and turns everyday choices into powerful insights about your health and longevity.

Smarter Food Tracking, Powered by AI

Snap a photo. Type a few words. That’s it.
Beyond Macros uses cutting-edge AI to instantly recognize your meals and analyze nutritional content—no barcode scanning or tedious data entry required.

Go Beyond Macros

Sure, we give you protein, carbs, and fat—but that’s just the start.
We break down your meals with deep nutritional analysis that includes:
	•	Macro & micronutrient profiles
	•	Food quality scoring
	•	Lifespan impact estimation
	•	AI-powered nutrition insights tailored to your goals

AI Nutrition Insights

Unlock powerful, personalized health guidance.
Our AI goes beyond static tracking to deliver real-time, actionable insights about how your diet impacts:
	•	Energy levels
	•	Body composition
	•	Long-term health outcomes
	•	Longevity & vitality

Eat for Longevity

Every bite you log influences your health span.
Beyond Macros uniquely calculates the Lifespan Impact Score for each meal—helping you make decisions today that add healthy years to your life.

Designed for People Who Want More

Whether you’re tracking macros for fitness, reversing chronic conditions, or simply eating for a longer, better life—Beyond Macros puts next-level nutrition in your pocket.
